name: Brooklyn Bridge Animal Welfare Coalition (BBAWC) / Brooklyn Cat Cafe
neighborhoods: All of Brooklyn (Kings County) for vetting & fostering support
notes: 501(c)(3) coalition of rescuers (EIN 26-1482964), founded 2007, 8,000+ cats rescued. Not a traditional shelter. Serves all Kings County for vetting/fostering; does NOT run TNR projects itself (refers to Neighborhood Cats/FCI) but runs the BBAWC Rescue Clinic (spay/neuter) inside the Brooklyn Cat Cafe. PO Box 22948, Brooklyn 11202. Re-verified 2026-08-26. Other channel: Brooklyn Cat Cafe: (347) 946-2286, 76 Montague St Other channel: catcafebk.com
